snippet.title: SCHROTT: Roguelike Racer – Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Roguelite meets racing in SCHROTT: Roguelike Racer. Choose your driver, combine abilities and build your car from more than 30 different parts as you race through six maps and create your perfect run.

With three drivers, five abilities and almost endless customization possibilities, every run gives you new ways to build, race and survive.

Wishlist SCHROTT: Roguelike Racer now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427070/SCHROTT_Roguelike_Racer/
